faq.q: What is a titanium ultrasonic horn 20khz?
faq.a: A titanium ultrasonic horn 20khz is a precision-machined ultrasonic tooling component used in 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic welding horn (sonotrode). Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Triaxially Forged) for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium ultrasonic horn 20khz?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz is designed for 20khz cylindrical ultrasonic welding horn (sonotrode). The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Triaxially Forged) grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium ultrasonic horn 20khz manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Horn 20kHz is manufactured using Triaxial forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium ultrasonic horn 20khz?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
